question: What rebates are available for a heat pump?
html:
We don't keep a confirmed list of heat pump rebates, and amounts change by utility, state and date. Our technician checks the programs that apply to your address during the estimate and lists them on your quote before you commit.

What usually decides eligibility

  • Your service address. Our customers span nine Central PA counties plus Ocean and Monmouth counties in NJ (Punctual Pros market profile). Programs differ across that area.
  • Your current heating fuel. Programs often treat a switch from oil or propane differently from a gas or electric upgrade.
  • The equipment and installer. Many programs specify efficiency levels and paperwork. We confirm these with you on the quote.

We can't advise on tax treatment. Please check any tax credit with your tax preparer.

Where switching matters most

Many homes we serve still heat with oil or propane. They are the most likely candidates for a heat pump conversion.

AreaHomes heating with oil or propane
Perry County44.5%
Lebanon County37.6%
Berks County30.0%
Adams County27.7%
Lancaster County25.2%
Ocean and Monmouth, NJMostly utility gas (78-81%)

Source: Punctual Pros market profile, based on the 2020-2024 Census five-year survey.

What would answer this fully

Our data has no rebate amounts, so we won't quote any. A complete answer needs:

  • Current heat pump rebate schedules from each electric and gas utility in our service area.
  • Active Pennsylvania and New Jersey program terms, checked as of Oct 8, 2026.
  • Current manufacturer promotions on the models we install.

About 241k core Central PA households heat with oil or propane (est., Punctual Pros market profile). Accurate rebate answers turn those calls into replacement jobs instead of quotes that go to a competitor.

Next actions

  • Build a rebate lookup for the 248 core Central PA zip codes and the NJ footprint. Map each zip to its utility and state programs. Review it every quarter.
  • Add heating fuel type to the booking script and the AI voice dispatcher so oil and propane leads get flagged for a conversion estimate.
  • Add a rebate line to every heat pump quote, with the source and the date checked.
  • Once rebate data is loaded, rank Perry, Lebanon and Berks for a targeted conversion campaign.
